1.12.2.1.0.14:
- Feature: explosion synthesis - drop a Singularity and an Iron Ingot/Block on the ground and detonate an explosion to transform them into a Time Inscriber Template (JEI shows the method as text info; new explosion config category)
- Change: removed the crafting-table recipe for the Time Inscriber Template (obtain via explosion synthesis or inscriber replication)
- Change: Time Wand default speed multipliers are now 32,64,128,256,512
- Fix: Time Wand no longer charges for clicks on non-acceleratable targets; MM controllers show a targeted hint when MM acceleration is disabled
- Fix: Time Wand batch transfer with ME Import/Export Buses works from any angle (precise part hit detection)
- Fix: Time Wand MM recipe acceleration is tracked and cleaned up on machine removal / chunk unload / shutdown
- Perf: single Time Wand click workload is capped (512 tile updates / 2048 random ticks); extreme configs no longer overflow
- Fix: particle bursts are broadcast by the server (visible to all players)
- Fix: wand preview highlight now matches behavior (sneak only, 4.5 block reach, all acceleratable blocks)
1.12.2.1.0.13:
- Feature: Mek generator acceleration (wind/gas/bio/solar/heat/large): Nx energy per tick without extra fuel, free power
- Fix: Time Bus GUI speed/range/power now sync from the server part
- Change: config reorganized into categories (bus/timeGenerator/wand/mm/mek) - delete timebus.cfg once after updating
- Change: config fields & descriptions localized (zh/en)
- Test: JUnit skeleton with 16 passing tests
1.12.2.1.0.12:
- Mek: recipe-tick burst acceleration at the shared RecipeCacheLookupMonitor layer, covering every recipe-driven machine; accelerated per-tick energy draw is reported via Mek's sync channel
- Fix: redstone / power loss now stops MM acceleration immediately and restores injected modifiers
- Fix: Random Complement compatibility for the inscriber (no extra input eaten, no infinite production)
1.12.2.1.0.11: - Fix: vanilla Forge 1.12.2 clients can now load the mod (Java 8 class target, no Cleanroom-only ModType attribute)
1.12.2.1.0.10:
- Fix: mod version now sourced from gradle.properties
- Mek: virtual speed cards use the real max installed count (configurable) and round up
1.12.2.1.0.9:
- Fix: multiple Time Buses no longer overwrite / clear each other's MM acceleration
- Fix: Time Wand no longer leaves MM controllers permanently accelerated; injected modifiers are cleaned up on chunk unload
- Perf: MM acceleration skips the per-tick reflection sweep in steady state
1.12.2.1.0.8:
- MM: energy cost now follows the speed-up (new option, total energy per recipe stays constant)
- MM: force refresh of pooled recipe contexts every 20 ticks so threads never stay unaccelerated
1.12.2.1.0.7:
- Time Fluid Generator: consumes up to 64 inputs per update so Time Bus acceleration speeds it up

- MM: new Keep Idle Threads option for factory controllers
1.12.2.1.0.6:
- MM: acceleration now stacks per source and supports factory controllers
- Fix: pulse mode completes the whole batch; fluid billing matches what was drained
- Perf: config strings parsed once and cached; unloaded chunks skipped cheaply
1.12.2.1.0.5:
- MM: acceleration via recipe-duration modifiers (opt-in)
- Time Wand: cell size configurable; emptying into the Time Fluid Generator no longer destroys fluid
- Dev: CraftTweaker FMLAT entries merged
1.12.2.1.0.4:
